cases.sentence: ___ говорил с Израилем в ночном видении и сказал «Иаков, Иаков».
cases.translation: God spoke with Israel in a night vision and said, 'Jacob, Jacob.'
cases.explain: Бог is the subject of the verb говорил, so it stands in the nominative case.
The preposition из (out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: «Я пойду к ___ и скажу ему, мои братья и дом моего отца пришли ко мне».
cases.translation: 'I will go to Pharaoh and tell him: my brothers and my father's household have come to me.'
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он взял с собой в Египет сыновей и внуков, дочерей и внучек, все свое ___.
cases.translation: He took with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons, his daughters and granddaughters, all his offspring.
cases.explain: The transitive verb взял (took) governs its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Иаков со всей ___ переселяется в Египет.
cases.translation: Jacob moves to Egypt with his whole family.
cases.explain: The preposition со (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Сыновья Израиля посадили отца, детей и жен в ___, которые фараон прислал, чтобы перевезти его.
cases.translation: The sons of Israel put their father, the children, and the wives in the wagons that Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location (riding inside) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Израиль отправился в путь со всем, что у него было, пришел в Версавию и принес там жертвы Богу, своего отца Исаака.
reading.question: What did Israel do when he arrived at Beersheba?
options: He offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac
He built an altar to Pharaoh
reading.correct: He offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac
reading.explain: At Beersheba, Israel offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

reading.ru: Не бойся пойти в Египет, потому что я произведу от тебя там великий народ.
reading.question: What did God promise Jacob about going down to Egypt?
options: That God would make a great nation from him there
That the famine would end immediately
reading.correct: That God would make a great nation from him there
reading.explain: God tells Jacob not to fear going to Egypt, for there He will make of him a great nation.

reading.ru: Всего членов семьи Иакова, пришедших в Египет, было 70 человек.
reading.question: How many members of Jacob's family came to Egypt in total?
reading.explain: The text states the total number of Jacob's family who came to Egypt was 70.

reading.ru: Иаков послал перед собой к Иосифу Иуду, чтобы узнать путь в Гошен.
reading.question: Whom did Jacob send ahead to Joseph to find the way to Goshen?
reading.explain: Jacob sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph, to learn the way to Goshen.

reading.ru: Он предстал перед ним, обнял его и долго плакал.
reading.question: What did Joseph do when he met his father Israel in Goshen?
options: He embraced him and wept for a long time
He introduced him to Pharaoh immediately
reading.correct: He embraced him and wept for a long time
reading.explain: Joseph presented himself, embraced his father, and wept for a long time.

reading.ru: Эти люди пастухи, они разводят скот и привели с собой свои стада и принесли все свое имущество.
reading.question: How did Joseph describe his brothers' occupation to Pharaoh?
options: They are shepherds who raise livestock
reading.correct: They are shepherds who raise livestock
reading.explain: Joseph describes his brothers as shepherds who raise livestock.

reading.ru: Тогда вам будет позволено поселиться в земле Гошен, потому что египтянам отвратительны пастухи».
reading.question: Why would the brothers be allowed to settle specifically in Goshen?
options: Because shepherds were detestable to the Egyptians
Because Goshen had the best water
Because it was closest to Egypt's capital
reading.correct: Because shepherds were detestable to the Egyptians
reading.explain: Because shepherds were detestable to the Egyptians, the family would be settled apart, in Goshen.
